summary.highest_priority_new_finding: WAVE-B-A11Y-CRIT — aria-required-children on profile menu (admin sidebar) on POS/KDS/OSS (3 instances, same root cause)

color-contrast-brand-orange.pattern: White #ffffff text on brand orange #f4501e — contrast ratio 3.49 (WCAG AA needs 4.5:1)
color-contrast-brand-orange.fix_recommendation: Either darken brand orange or use a darker text color in CTAs. Affects 4 surfaces, 21 nodes. Same root design token.

aria-required-children-profile-menu.pattern: Profile menu component (#profile-menu-xxxxx) has ARIA role with disallowed children (figure[tabindex], h3[tabindex], input[aria-label])
aria-required-children-profile-menu.fix_recommendation: Review admin sidebar profile menu component ARIA structure. Likely a single shared admin-shell component (likely AdminProfileMenuComponent or similar) since the bug repeats verbatim on 3 admin surfaces.
aria-required-children-profile-menu.owner_visible_note: Screen reader users + axe scan will see, but visual users unaffected.

fcp-admin-spa-3.4s.pattern: FCP ~3.4s on all 3 admin SPA surfaces — admin-shell.js (5.99 MB) + app.js (7.0 MB) parse+execute dominate
fcp-admin-spa-3.4s.fix_recommendation: Code splitting on admin chunks; lazy-load by route. V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne may be acceptable but slow POS hardware will compound.
fcp-admin-spa-3.4s.owner_visible_note: Owner sees admin pages take ~3.5s for first paint; perceived as slow on cold load.

ship_cleared_rationale: Verdict HAS_ISSUES but no P0/no V1 blocker. 3 P1 = same shared profile-menu ARIA bug (screen-reader-only, not visual). 7 P2 = brand color contrast + admin SPA cold-load FCP. T2-LIV-P1-01 i18n raw labels on /admin/delivery-boy-cash-sessions/1 already documented separately. Owner trial can proceed; backlog these to V1.0.2 or V1.0.3 polish.
